compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is titled "Product rating" and allows users to filter products based on their ratings. The screen displays a list of rating categories, each represented by a series of stars:

1. Five stars (5) - 5 products have a perfect rating.
2. Four stars and up (8) - 8 products have a rating of four stars or higher.
3. Three stars and up (10) - 10 products have a rating of three stars or higher.
4. Two stars and up (10) - 10 products have a rating of two stars or higher.
5. One star and up (13) - 13 products have a rating of one star or higher.

Users can select a rating category to filter and view products that meet the selected rating criteria.
